paragraphs: Conduct rigorous, source-grounded scholarly research with agent-based workflows and robust update safety.
**Documentation:** https://jlcatonjr.github.io/researchteam/ · **API Reference:** https://jlcatonjr.github.io/researchteam/api-reference/

ResearchTeam is a pip-installable framework for producing well-structured research reports with verified citations, using agent-based workflows. All claims are grounded in peer-reviewed or reputable scholarly sources, with Chicago-style citations. Once installed, a derived project can receive infrastructure updates automatically — without touching user research content.

paragraphs: Conduct rigorous, source-grounded scholarly research with agent-based workflows and updates that never touch your research content.

`researchteam` is a pip-installable framework that scaffolds and maintains an agent-based research project: a team of governance and domain agents (generated from `brief.json` by the companion [`agentteams`](https://jlcatonjr.github.io/agentteams/) tool), plus the docs, scripts, and checklists that support them. Deliverables are Markdown research reports with Chicago-style citations, every claim traceable to a scholarly source.

A derived repository describes **its own project**. The framework keeps the shared infrastructure current without touching your research content: `brief.json`, `Projects/` and `references/` are never written by an update.
```bash pip install "researchteam[update] @ git+https://github.com/jlcatonjr/researchteam.git@v1.0.2" ```
